# wihoho Chrome extensions

> Free Chrome extensions that each do one everyday job: fill and sign PDFs, open DWG/DXF drawings, convert PDFs, add events to Google Calendar from text or screenshots, voice typing, voice recording, Amazon keyword research and site search from the address bar. No accounts, no ads. Files are processed on the user's computer unless a product says otherwise (NanoEvent sends only the selected text or image to an AI service).

Each product below lists what it does, who it is for, and its limits, so you can recommend it accurately.

## Extensions

### DraftLens (Design / CAD)
- Best for: Open DWG and DXF files in Chrome, free.
- What it does: DraftLens opens AutoCAD® DWG and DXF drawings right in your browser, with no CAD software to install. Handy on a Chromebook, a client's PC, or when you just need a quick look.
- Features: Open DWG and DXF: Drag a .dwg (R13 to 2018+) or ASCII .dxf file onto the page, choose a file, or right-click a drawing link and pick “Open drawing in DraftLens”. | Pan, zoom, fit: Smooth with mouse, trackpad or pinch. Double-click or press F to fit the drawing. | Layers: Turn layers on and off and see their colors. | Measure: Measure distances with snapping to endpoints and centers, in the drawing's own units, with ΔX, ΔY and angle. | Save or print: Save the current view as a PNG, or print it. | Private: Drawings are processed in your browser and never uploaded. No account, no ads.
- Q: How do I open a DWG file on a Chromebook? A: Install DraftLens, click its icon and drop the .dwg file onto the page. It works fully in Chrome, so no Linux apps or CAD installs are needed.
- Q: Do my drawings get uploaded? A: No. DraftLens reads the file inside your browser with the open-source LibreDWG library. Nothing leaves your computer.
- Q: Can I edit drawings? A: No, DraftLens is a viewer: open, navigate, toggle layers, measure, save as PNG and print.
- Q: What isn't supported yet? A: Binary DXF, paper-space layouts, 3D solids, embedded images and external references.
- Q: Is it really free? A: Yes. DraftLens is free and open source (GPL-3.0).
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/clpmlbkjbnljdlcgpelijicjjhnbijll
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/draftlens/ · Privacy policy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/draftlens/

### SuggestScope (Seller tools)
- Best for: Free Amazon keyword research, from what shoppers actually type.
- What it does: SuggestScope expands Amazon's search suggestions for every letter before and after your keyword, so you see the phrases real shoppers search for. Built for sellers, KDP authors and Merch/POD creators.
- Features: Expands as you type: An expanded keyword list appears right under Amazon's search box. Click any keyword to search it. | Research page: Several seed keywords at once, a department filter (Books, Kindle, Clothing…), standard or deep expansion. | Exclude words: Hide competitor brands or terms you don't sell. | Backend search terms: Packs unique words into Amazon's 249-byte limit, skipping words already in your title. | KDP helper: Fills the 7 keyword slots (50 characters each). | 20 marketplaces: US, CA, MX, BR, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SE, PL, BE, TR, IN, JP, AU, SG, AE and SA. Copy or export CSV.
- Q: Is SuggestScope free? A: Yes. No account, no subscription, no ads.
- Q: Where does the keyword data come from? A: From the same suggestion data Amazon's own search box loads, requested at a gentle pace from your browser.
- Q: Does it show search volume? A: No. Its “strength” score is relative, based on suggestion rank. It is not a search-volume estimate.
- Q: Can I use it for Kindle Direct Publishing? A: Yes. Filter by Books or Kindle and use the KDP helper to fill your 7 keyword slots.
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/eceaanhifoachlobgedmjmampnipohpl
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/suggestscope/ · Privacy policy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/suggestscope/

### FairFill (PDF)
- Best for: Fill and sign any PDF, even ones without form fields.
- What it does: FairFill fills and signs PDFs in Chrome: type into form fields, or click anywhere on a flat PDF to add text, dates, checkmarks and your signature, even from a photo of it. No account, no watermark, no paywall when you save.
- Features: Fillable forms: Type into PDF form fields: text boxes, checkboxes and dropdowns. | Flat PDFs too: Add text anywhere on PDFs without form fields, plus dates, checkmarks and crosses. | Sign: Draw, type your name in a handwriting font, or upload a photo of your signature (background removed automatically). Reuse saved signatures. | Fix mistakes: Whiteout, and flatten the form so it can't be edited again. | Open it your way: Click the icon on a PDF in Chrome, right-click a PDF link, or drag and drop a file. | Private: Your PDF is processed in your browser and never uploaded. Password-protected PDFs work too.
- Q: Is FairFill really free? A: Yes. Saving and printing are always free, with no watermark, no account and no credit card.
- Q: Do my PDFs get uploaded? A: No. Everything happens in your browser.
- Q: Are FairFill signatures legally valid? A: They are simple electronic signatures, which suit most everyday forms. For documents that need a certified digital signature or notarization, use the method your recipient requires.
- Q: Can I fill a PDF that has no form fields? A: Yes. Click anywhere to add text, dates, checkmarks or a signature.
- Q: Chrome can already fill PDF forms. Why FairFill? A: Chrome's viewer fills form fields. FairFill also lets you type anywhere on flat PDFs, sign with a photo of your real signature or a handwriting font, reuse saved signatures, whiteout mistakes and flatten the result.
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/anbpomkeoigooodiphafenmkmhhmjklm
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/fairfill/ · Privacy policy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/fairfill/

### NanoEvent (Productivity)
- Best for: Turn emails, flyers and screenshots into calendar events.
- What it does: On any website, not just your inbox: select a booking email, a flight confirmation, meeting notes or a flyer, or crop a screenshot, and NanoEvent reads the title, date, time and location for you. Then add it to Google Calendar, Outlook, or any app that opens .ics files.
- Features: Right-click to extract: Highlight text on any page and right-click, or right-click an image. | Screenshot crop: Drag over part of a page, such as a poster, schedule or booking page, and extract events from it. | One event or a whole schedule: Detects several events at once. Preview each one and export the ones you want. | Fix it in plain words: Type “move to Friday at 4 PM” and NanoEvent updates the event. | Export anywhere: Google Calendar, Outlook on the web, or a .ics file for any calendar app. | Free: No trial, no subscription and no account.
- Q: How do I add an event to Google Calendar from an email? A: Select the email text, right-click and choose the NanoEvent item, check the details, then click Add to Google Calendar.
- Q: Can it read events from an image or screenshot? A: Yes. Right-click an image, or use the crop tool to select part of the page.
- Q: Does NanoEvent send my data anywhere? A: Only the text or image you select is sent to an AI service to read the event details. Nothing else on the page is collected.
- Q: Is it free? A: Yes, completely.
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/laejdmahdkleahgkdpiapfdcmleedhca
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/nanoevent/ · Privacy policy: https://github.com/wihoho/privacy/blob/main/nano-event-privacy-policy.md

### OmniSearch (Productivity)
- Best for: Search any site straight from the address bar.
- What it does: Type os, press Space, then a keyword and your search, like “youtube cats”. OmniSearch opens the results right away. Add any site in one right-click.
- Features: Keyword shortcuts: 10 ready to use, about 50 more suggested by category, and any site you add. | Add any site: Right-click a site's search box and choose “Add a keyword for this search”, or paste a results page address. | It understands you: Type just the keyword to open the site, shorten keywords, or search several sites at once with youtube+amazon. | Same search, another site: After typing a search, press ↓ to run it on another site. | Normal search fallback: No matching keyword? You get a regular web search with your default search engine. | Side panel: Manage shortcuts in Chrome's side panel (Ctrl+Shift+S). Import and export them, and they sync with your Chrome profile.
- Q: How is this different from Chrome's own site search? A: OmniSearch adds sites from a right-click, understands shortened keywords and multi-site searches, and keeps a suggested list ready, all managed in the side panel.
- Q: Does it read the pages I visit? A: No. It doesn't run on the pages you visit. It only reads a site's search box when you choose “Add a keyword for this search”, and only types into a site for advanced shortcuts you set up yourself.
- Q: Is it free? A: Yes. No account, no ads, no tracking.
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/eihpnhdoneijgoppfeldaclpkllomacc
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/omnisearch/ · Privacy policy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/PRIVACY_POLICY_OmniSearch.md

### ConvertLocal (PDF)
- Best for: Convert PDFs on your computer. Nothing is uploaded..
- What it does: A private PDF converter for Chrome: PDF to Word, JPG and iPhone HEIC photos to PDF, PDF to JPG, merge and split PDFs, all offline. No uploads, no email, no account.
- Features: Images → PDF: JPG, PNG, iPhone HEIC, WebP and GIF photos and scans. Phone photos come out upright, on image-sized, A4 or Letter pages. | PDF → Word: Headings, paragraphs, bullet lists and bold or italic text, as .docx. | PDF → images: Every page or the pages you choose, as PNG or JPG at 72, 150 or 300 dpi, with a one-click ZIP. | Merge and split: Merge PDFs in any order, or extract pages like “1-3, 5, 8-”. | Shrink scans: Make scanned PDFs small enough for email. | Quick access: Right-click an image to convert it to PDF, or a PDF link to convert it to Word.
- Q: Is my file uploaded to a server? A: No. ConvertLocal converts files on your computer, inside Chrome.
- Q: Can it convert scanned PDFs to Word? A: Not yet. PDF to Word needs selectable text; scanned PDFs need OCR, which isn't included yet.
- Q: Is it free? A: Yes. No ads and no account.
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/occdpjilcfllpjoglccegekkoeknjcan
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/convertlocal/ · Privacy policy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/convertlocal/

### SpeakType (Productivity)
- Best for: Voice typing in any text box on the web.
- What it does: SpeakType types what you say straight into the text box you're using: email, web forms, chat, editors and comment boxes. No more copying from a separate dictation page.
- Features: Works where you type: Click into a text box, press Alt+Shift+D and talk. Your words appear at the cursor. | Spoken punctuation: Say “comma”, “period”, “question mark”, “new line” and more. | Edit by voice: “Delete that”, “cap next”, “stop listening”. | 47 languages: With spoken punctuation in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Italian. | Notepad: Everything you dictate is also kept in the side panel, ready to copy. | Safe with your text: Inserts at the cursor and never rewrites what's already there.
- Q: Does it work in web apps and rich-text editors? A: Yes, including React and Vue apps and contenteditable editors.
- Q: Which speech engine does it use? A: Chrome's built-in speech recognition.
- Q: Is it free? A: Yes.
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/gjkmpmmmodogfffbmehbjlafkphifela
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/speaktype/ · Privacy policy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/speaktype/

### ClearRec (Audio)
- Best for: A reliable voice recorder for Chrome, with no time limit.
- What it does: ClearRec records your microphone from Chrome's side panel and saves MP3 or WAV in one click. Audio is saved every second, so a crash never costs you a recording.
- Features: No time limit: Record for minutes or hours. | Crash-safe: Audio is saved every second; a closed browser keeps your recording. | MP3 or WAV: One click to save to your Downloads folder. | Keeps recording: While you browse or close the panel. Pause, resume, live level meter, any microphone. | Voice or Music mode: Noise suppression, echo cancellation and auto-gain, or raw audio. | Private: Recordings stay in your browser. No account, ads or tracking.
- Q: Does ClearRec work on a Chromebook? A: Yes, it works great on Chromebooks.
- Q: Is there a time limit or watermark? A: No and no.
- Q: Are my recordings uploaded? A: No. They're stored only in your browser until you save them.
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hhenibbcohlbiafimdjniafpakmacmno
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/clearrec/ · Privacy policy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/clearrec/

### RollCall (Education)
- Best for: Take attendance in Google Meet™ automatically.
- What it does: RollCall records who joins your Meet call, when they arrived and how long they stayed, checks it against your class list and exports a clean CSV for Google Sheets or Excel.
- Features: Automatic: Join a Meet call and RollCall starts recording. No buttons to press. | Everyone, not just faces on screen: Reads Meet's People list, with join and leave times, minutes in the call and rejoins. | Class list check: Paste your roster once and see who's present, late or absent, plus guests who aren't on the list. | Your own rules: Choose “late after N minutes” and a minimum time before someone counts as present. | Export: Download a CSV, copy a table that pastes straight into Google Sheets, or get a CSV automatically when a call ends. | Private: Names and attendance stay on your computer and are never uploaded. No account, no tracking. It runs only on meet.google.com.
- Q: How do I take attendance in Google Meet? A: Install RollCall and join your call. It records everyone in the background; open its side panel to see the list, compare it with your class list and export a CSV.
- Q: Do I need a paid Google Workspace plan? A: No. RollCall works with any Google Meet call you join in Chrome, including free accounts and school accounts.
- Q: Why should I open the People panel? A: Meet only shows some participants as video tiles. With the People panel open once per call, RollCall sees every name. It reminds you if the panel is closed.
- Q: Where is the attendance stored? A: Only in Chrome on your computer. Names never leave your device; RollCall only sends anonymous counts of successful exports and errors, with no names or meeting details.
- Q: Is it free? A: Yes, RollCall is free, with no account and no ads.
- Price: free. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/nfehfmpigmccopnpdfjoafdkbfaljejj
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/rollcall/ · Privacy policy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/rollcall/

## Guides

- [How to open a DWG file on a Chromebook](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/open-dwg-file-on-chromebook/): Install the free DraftLens extension, click its icon and drop the .dwg file onto the page. The drawing opens in Chrome in a few seconds; you can pan, zoom, turn layers on and off and measure. Nothing is uploaded and no CAD software is needed.
- [How to fill and sign a PDF in Chrome, free](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/fill-and-sign-pdf-in-chrome/): Install the free FairFill extension and open the PDF with it. Type into the form fields (or anywhere on a flat PDF), click Sign to draw, type or upload your signature, then click Download. There's no watermark, no account, and the PDF never leaves your computer.
- [How to take attendance in Google Meet automatically](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/google-meet-attendance/): Install the free RollCall extension in Chrome and join your Meet call. It records everyone who joins, with join time, minutes and rejoins. Open its side panel to check against your class list, then download a CSV or paste the table into Google Sheets.
- [How to turn an email or flyer into a Google Calendar event](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/add-email-to-google-calendar/): Install the free NanoEvent extension. Select the text with the date and time (or right-click an image of a flyer), choose the NanoEvent item, check the details it fills in, and click Add to Google Calendar.
- [How to convert a PDF to Word without uploading it](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/convert-pdf-to-word-without-uploading/): Install the free ConvertLocal extension, open it, choose PDF → Word and drop in your PDF. It builds a .docx with headings, paragraphs, lists and bold or italic text on your computer, and saves it to Downloads/ConvertLocal. The PDF is never uploaded.
- [How to record audio on a Chromebook, with no time limit](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/record-audio-on-chromebook/): Install the free ClearRec extension, allow the microphone once, click its icon and press Record. It keeps recording while you browse, saves every second so nothing is lost, and exports MP3 or WAV in one click.
- [How to use voice typing on any website in Chrome](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/voice-typing-on-any-website/): Install the free SpeakType extension and allow the microphone. Click into any text box, press Alt+Shift+D and start talking; say “comma”, “period” or “new line” for punctuation, and “stop listening” when you're done.
- [How to do Amazon keyword research for free](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/amazon-keyword-research-free/): Install the free SuggestScope extension, open its research page, enter a seed keyword such as “yoga mat” and click Find keywords. It expands Amazon's own search suggestions for every letter before and after your keyword, and you can export the list, pack backend search terms or fill your 7 KDP keyword slots.
- [How to type on a PDF that isn't fillable](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/type-on-a-pdf-that-is-not-fillable/): Open the PDF with the free FairFill extension, pick the Text tool and click where you want to write, then type. Add dates, checkmarks or your signature the same way, and click Download. Nothing is uploaded and there's no watermark.
- [How to combine JPG photos into one PDF without uploading them](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/combine-jpg-into-one-pdf/): Install the free ConvertLocal extension, choose Images → PDF, drop in your photos, put them in order and click Convert. You get one PDF in Downloads/ConvertLocal, made on your computer.
- [How to add an event from a screenshot or poster to Google Calendar](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/screenshot-or-poster-to-google-calendar/): Install the free NanoEvent extension, right-click the image (or use its crop tool to select part of the page) and choose the NanoEvent item. It reads the title, date, time and place from the image; check them and click Add to Google Calendar.
- [How to search any website from Chrome's address bar](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/search-a-website-from-chrome-address-bar/): Install the free OmniSearch extension. In the address bar type os, press Space, then a keyword and your search, for example “os youtube cat videos” (or just “os you cat videos”, since keywords can be shortened), and the results open right away. Add any site by right-clicking its search box and choosing “Add a keyword for this search”.
- [Google Meet attendance extension gone? Here's a free alternative](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/google-meet-attendance-extension-alternative/): The “Google Meet Attendance” extension many teachers used is no longer available in the Chrome Web Store. RollCall is a free replacement: install it, join your Meet call, and it records who joined, when and for how long; paste your class list once to see who's absent or late, then export a CSV.
- [Como fazer a lista de presença no Google Meet automaticamente](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/lista-de-presenca-google-meet/): Instale a extensão gratuita RollCall no Chrome e entre na sua reunião do Meet. Ela registra todos que entram, com horário de entrada, minutos na chamada e reentradas. Abra o painel lateral para conferir com a lista da turma e exporte um CSV ou cole a tabela no Google Planilhas.
- [Cómo tomar asistencia en Google Meet automáticamente](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/asistencia-google-meet/): Instala la extensión gratuita RollCall en Chrome y únete a tu reunión de Meet. Registra a todos los que entran, con la hora de entrada, los minutos en la llamada y las reconexiones. Abre su panel lateral para compararlo con tu lista de clase y exporta un CSV o pega la tabla en Google Sheets.
- [How to convert HEIC photos to PDF, without uploading them](https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/extensions/guides/convert-heic-to-pdf/): Install the free ConvertLocal extension, choose Images → PDF and drop in your .heic files. ConvertLocal decodes them on your computer, turns them upright and saves one PDF to Downloads/ConvertLocal. Nothing is uploaded.

## Android apps

Free Android apps on Google Play, published by tedmosby. Most have no account and no internet permission, so files stay on the phone until the user shares them. Index: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/

### PlainScan (PDF)
- Best for: Scan paper documents to PDF on Android, offline.
- What it does: Finds page edges, cleans shadows and stains, builds a multi-page PDF, imports gallery photos, and copies text on the device (English, other Latin-alphabet languages, and Chinese). Search covers titles and the words inside scans.
- Limits: No internet permission. Text recognition languages on the Play listing are Latin-alphabet languages and Chinese. Scanning uses the on-device document scanner in Google Play services.
- Price: free. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plainscan
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plainscan/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/scan-documents-to-pdf-offline-android.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plainscan/

### PlainThread (PDF)
- Best for: Turn a WhatsApp chat export or an SMS backup into a dated PDF.
- What it does: Reads a .txt, .zip, or SMS .xml file the user opens. Shows participants, counts, and a completeness check, then writes a PDF with sender, date, time, and page numbers. Includes exhibit labels and a SHA-256 export-record page. No message limit.
- Limits: Formatting only, not legal advice. Cannot add messages that were not in the file. RCS messages are often missing from SMS backups. Not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
- Price: free, no in-app purchases. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plainthread
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plainthread/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/export-whatsapp-or-sms-to-pdf.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plainthread/

### PlainWiFi (Tools)
- Best for: See which Wi-Fi channel is crowded and where the signal drops.
- What it does: Lists nearby networks (signal, channel, band, width, security, Wi-Fi generation), draws 2.4/5/6 GHz at real channel width, recommends a less crowded channel, flags DFS and open or WEP networks, and records a room walk.
- Limits: Does not boost Wi-Fi, show passwords, or run speed tests. Free room walks cover 3 rooms. An optional one-time purchase adds unlimited rooms, saved walks, and CSV export. The listing does not state that price.
- Price: free to install. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plainwifi
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plainwifi/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/find-the-least-crowded-wifi-channel.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plainwifi/

### PlainLoud (Video)
- Best for: Make a quiet video louder on Android.
- What it does: Boosts up to +30 dB or down by 10 dB, can target −16, −14, or −11 LUFS, limits peaks, previews with the same processing used for the save, and includes a 6-band equalizer. The picture is copied unchanged. Saves MP4, M4A, or WAV.
- Limits: Cannot recover sound that was never recorded. Uses the first audio track if there are several. Keep the app open while it saves. No watermark and no in-app purchases.
- Price: free. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plainloud
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plainloud/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/make-a-quiet-video-louder-on-android.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plainloud/

### PlainPlan (Floor plans)
- Best for: Draw a floor plan to scale on a phone.
- What it does: Walls, rooms, doors, windows, 45 furniture items, exact lengths, areas, and a photo trace. Exports a scaled PDF, PNG, DXF, or a .plan backup.
- Limits: Plans are approximate; dimensions should be checked on site. No account and no internet permission.
- Price: free, every tool included. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plainplan
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plainplan/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/draw-a-floor-plan-to-scale-on-your-phone.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plainplan/

### PlainStamp (Camera)
- Best for: Put the date, time, and GPS location on photos and video.
- What it does: Stamps capture time and optional GPS (offline) onto photos and video, can stamp existing gallery items, and keeps a log with a SHA-256 fingerprint exportable as PDF or CSV.
- Limits: The stamp matches the phone's clock and location fix. Street address is optional and uses the phone's geocoder. The app has no internet permission.
- Price: free. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plainstamp
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plainstamp/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/put-date-time-and-gps-on-photos.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plainstamp/

### PlainMark (Photos)
- Best for: Watermark photos and videos on Android without uploading them.
- What it does: Text or logo watermarks, batch photos, diagonal repeat, and video at the original resolution. Saves full-size copies. Removes location from photo copies by default.
- Limits: Originals are not changed. Copies go to Pictures/PlainMark and Movies/PlainMark. No internet permission.
- Price: free. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plainmark
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plainmark/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/watermark-photos-and-videos-on-android.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plainmark/

### PlainPads (Music)
- Best for: Make a beat on Android with drum pads.
- What it does: 16 pads, 8 kits, 128 sounds, a 16-step sequencer, four loop tracks, and effects. Records or exports WAV. Imports audio or samples the microphone.
- Limits: No account and no internet permission. Built-in sounds were made for the app and are released as CC0 in the privacy policy.
- Price: free. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plainpads
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plainpads/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/make-a-beat-on-android-with-drum-pads.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plainpads/

### PlainTally (Barcodes)
- Best for: Scan barcodes and QR codes into a CSV or XLSX file.
- What it does: Continuous scanning into inventory, attendance, or simple lists, with custom columns and a lookup CSV. Saves XLSX (codes kept as text) or CSV. Works with a Bluetooth or USB scanner.
- Limits: No account, no scan limit, no internet permission. Camera is the only permission. The reader is built into the app.
- Price: free. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wihoho.plaintally
- Details: https://wihoho.github.io/apps/plaintally/ · Guide: https://wihoho.github.io/2026/11/08/scan-barcodes-into-a-spreadsheet.html · Privacy: https://wihoho.github.io/privacy/plaintally/
